status: REGISTERED BEFORE ANY PHONE RESULT EXISTS (no iPhone measurement has been made by anyone; every number in this repo about phone speed is a desktop number and is labelled so). The first five limits restate the pass criteria written at the end of Phase 6 (persistent-history/REPORT.md, section 8); the rest are new. A test (src/lib/review/phonetest.test.ts) keeps src/lib/review/phonetest.ts PHONE_CRITERIA equal to this file.

save250Ms.meaning: saving a 250-shot session's tracking history, milliseconds (it runs after the save and never blocks it)

list1000Ms.meaning: reading a history of 1,000+ shots (four 250-shot sessions)

renderPerShotMs.meaning: 95th percentile of building a shot's trail and drawing it on a 416 px canvas (the work of opening a shot in Session review), 100 shots

recorderP99Us.meaning: 99th percentile of the review recorder's cost per processed frame in the live loop, microseconds

stressSlowdown.meaning: five rounds of load-and-analyse over 1,000 shots: no failure, last round at most this many times the first

loopWorkIncreaseMs.meaning: median work per live-loop frame with Session review on minus off, from two real sets on the phone (needs 100+ frames each)

fpsDrop.meaning: frames per second with review off minus on, from the same two sets

batteryExtraPointsPer15Min.meaning: extra battery percentage points over a 15 minute set with review and retention on versus off, entered by hand (the browser cannot read the battery on iPhone)

countedShotsEqual.meaning: counted shots in a flag-on set equal a flag-off set of the same drill, checked by the player; the counting path is unchanged by construction and by the test suite but this is the real-phone check

what_a_browser_cannot_see: iPhone Safari offers no battery API, no thermal state, no JavaScript heap size and no per-process memory. The test reports those as 'not measured' and never as a pass. Memory pressure is therefore tested indirectly (five load-and-analyse rounds over 1,000 shots, slowdown and failures) and by noticing whether the page was reloaded by the phone mid-test (a run marker survives a reload). Storage eviction cannot be tested in minutes: the test records a marker and its age so the player can see, days later, whether it survived (Safari can clear the storage of a website that has not been opened for about a week unless it is added to the Home Screen or marked persistent).
decision_rule: Phase 7 does NOT claim any iPhone performance. When Matt runs the test, every check is pass / fail / not_measured against the limits above; the history feature stays off by default until the checks that could be measured pass on his phone.
